title: Maintain a cross-registry breeder sweep and explicit attribution correction list
rationale: A single registry materially overstates the visibility of some breeder pipelines, while repeated breeder and patent attribution errors appear in public sources. Reconcile CFIA, USPTO, CPVO, IP Australia and other relevant registers on a repeatable cadence, record denomination/selection/brand mappings, and preserve unresolved conflicts rather than silently choosing a secondary-source attribution.
